title: The World’s Perilous Ebola Complacency
gist: Tom Achoki, Nebiyu Dereje and Jean Kaseya warn that the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its deadliest, fastest-moving Ebola outbreak ever, with 10,193 cases and 4,960 deaths as of October 27 on an exponential trajectory. They urge global leaders to fund the Africa-led regional response now or pay a far higher human and economic price later.
